name: LiteLLM (Python SDK and proxy server)
loc: Python, 1855 files in the sdist; the advisories sit in litellm/proxy (about 390 files)
note: Public releases fetched by benchmark/real/fetch.mjs from PyPI (sdists, immutable), never vendored. 1.83.3 is the vulnerable target, 1.83.7 the fixed control. The sdist holds litellm/, enterprise/ and the packaging files, no docs/, ui/, tests/ or lockfile; litellm/proxy is identical to the git tag v1.83.3-stable. Run with `/security-audit --scope litellm/proxy`: both advisories are there, and a whole-repo run mostly measures the SDK.

advisories.type: SQL injection in the proxy's API key lookup, reachable without authentication
MCP server test endpoints start a stdio command for any API key holder (missing admin role check)
